title: Worksheet 8: Inappropriate Content (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Because Roblox allows everyday users to create their own games, not every experience on the platform is designed with children in mind, even though Roblox has rules and a review process meant to catch content that breaks its guidelines. Occasionally, games or user-created items may contain content that is not appropriate for kids, such as violent themes, inappropriate language, or images and ideas meant for older audiences. Sometimes inappropriate content is hidden inside a game that otherwise looks normal, only appearing after a player has already started playing. If a player ever comes across a game, image, or message that feels confusing, scary, or not appropriate, the safest choice is to leave the game immediately, avoid interacting further, and tell a trusted adult about what they saw. Roblox also provides a reporting tool that allows players to flag inappropriate games or content directly, which helps Roblox's safety team review and remove content that breaks the platform's rules.

questions.text: According to the paragraph, why is not every experience designed with children in mind?
questions.correct: Roblox allows everyday users to create their own games
distractors: Roblox only reviews games made by companies
Games are automatically made for adults
Children are not allowed to play most games

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what is the safest choice if a player sees something scary or confusing?
questions.correct: Leave the game immediately, avoid interacting, and tell a trusted adult
distractors: Keep playing to see if it goes away
Invite a friend to look at it too
Take a screenshot and post it publicly

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what does Roblox's reporting tool allow players to do?
questions.correct: Flag inappropriate games or content directly
distractors: Get a refund for Robux they spent
Change the rules of a game

questions.text: According to the paragraph, does Roblox have a review process for content?
questions.correct: Yes, it has rules and a review process, though some content still gets through
distractors: No, there are no rules at all
Yes, and it catches every problem perfectly
No, only players can review content

questions.text: A game looks completely normal at first, then shows something inappropriate later. Based on the paragraph, what does this show?
questions.correct: Inappropriate content is sometimes hidden and only appears after play begins
distractors: The game changed while it was being played
Only new games can contain hidden content
A filter must have been turned off by the player
